## Context / immutable basis

Implement from current `origin/main`, retain `d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84` as the immutable before-image, and keep both grouped leaves to one commit so path checks use `HEAD^..HEAD`.

## Boundary and immutable oracle
Below, `R` means `tests/unit/reconciler`. `D:<qualified-owner>` identifies only that owner's leading string docstring; `C:<anchor>@Lx-y` identifies one contiguous base comment region. Edit only these IDs. Every block must shrink and state current rationale/constraints; preserve cited literals and behavioral oracles.

Parse base/final source with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`; replace only allowlisted leading docstring values; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; require exact attribute-free AST equality. Tokenize independently to preserve directive/shebang text and inline/next-statement attachment. Runtime strings, inline comments, unlisted prose, executable syntax, and zero-context diff hunks outside the base spans remain exact.

- [ ] Runtime strings remain AST-identical.
